_about: MikroTik publishes no separate collateral: the product page IS the datasheet. mikrotik.com/product/<model> carries the full specification table, and /products/group/<family> is the family index above it.

rules.reason: MikroTik has no PDF datasheet and no document-type code; the product page itself carries the specification table, so the page IS the datasheet for this vendor.
the family index above the product pages - a discovery surface, not a fact source
